$PROBLEM EDS50 Model Visual Acuity $INPUT C ID TIME DOSEQ MDV DV REPL_ $DATA robust5_sim.dat ignore=@
$PRED MU_1=LOG(THETA(1)) MU_2=LOG(THETA(2)) MU_3=LOG(THETA(3)) MU_4=LOG(THETA(4)) MU_5=LOG(THETA(5)) MU_6=LOG(THETA(6))
IF(MDV==1) THEN DOSE=DOSEQ ELSE DOSE=DOSE ENDIF
VA0=EXP(MU_1+ETA(1)) KK=EXP(MU_2+ETA(2)) BETA=EXP(MU_3+ETA(3))
EMAXS=EXP(MU_4+ETA(4)) ED50S=EXP(MU_5+ETA(5)) GAMM=EXP(MU_6+ETA(6))
DG=DOSE**GAMM EE=EMAXS*DG/((ED50S**GAMM)+DG)
IPRED=VA0+(1.0-EXP(-KK*TIME))*(EE-BETA*VA0) Y=IPRED + EPS(1)
$THETA 55.0 ;[VA0] 0.005 ;[KK] 0.2 ; [BETA] 30.0 ;[EMAXS] 150.0 ;[ED50S] (2.0 FIXED) ;[GAMM]
$OMEGA 0.07 0.5 1.0 0.17 0.49 (0.0 FIXED) $SIGMA 28.0
$SIML (122345) SUBP=1 ONLYSIM
$TABLE C ID TIME DOSE MDV DV NOAPPEND NOPRINT ONEHEADER FILE=ed50s_fit.dat
